title: Flames shoot from Kuromanta during an excavation in a thunderstorm
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Flames shoot from Kuromanta during an excavation in a thunderstorm, about modern excavation at Japan (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They look back up and all of a sudden there's flames shooting out of the top of the mountain.

plain: A pyramid researcher, Geoffrey Drumm, describes an excavation at Kuromanta, a mountain in Akita, Japan, that some call a pyramid, drawing on a book by a man named Suzuki about the dig. He says that during a thunderstorm the diggers looked up and saw flames shooting out of the top of the mountain. If true, it would suggest the mountain is something more than an ordinary hill.
